ei.title: The Life of Althea Gibson, a Black Athlete, and Her Achievements Across Multiple Fields

fullPassage: Althea Gibson, an American tennis player and professional golfer, was born in 1927 and grew up in Harlem, New York. She dropped out of school in the seventh grade but returned several years later to finish high school. After graduation, she attended Florida A&M, a historically black college, on a basketball scholarship. She was the first Black tennis player ever to compete in the U.S. Open Tennis Championships and at Wimbledon. She won the French Championships in 1956, then went on to win both Wimbledon and the US Open in 1957 and again in 1958. In 1971, she entered the Tennis Hall of Fame. Gibson pursued many diverse interests. She released one record album, Althea Gibson Sings, and appeared in the film The Horse Soldier. In 1964, she became the first African American woman to enter the Ladies Professional Golf Association (LPGA).

❌ ① (A) 풀어주었다 - (B) 발매했다: 음반을 풀어주고 용의자를 발매하는 것은 부자연스러움.
❌ ② (A) 발매했다 - (B) 발매했다: (B)에서 용의자를 '발매'하는 것은 의미 불명.
❌ ③ (A) 풀어주었다 - (B) 풀어주었다: (A)에서 음반을 '풀어주다'는 부자연스러움.
det.tip: release: 1. 발매하다(put out a product) - 음반/영화 출시. 2. 풀어주다(set free) - 구속에서 해방.

"A sum of money given to a student to help pay for their education, usually because of their academic or athletic ability."

det.analysis:
✅ ② scholarship: 학업이나 운동 능력으로 학비를 지원받는 돈 = 장학금.
❌ ① salary: '급여'는 일한 대가.
❌ ③ penalty: '벌금/벌칙'은 학업 지원과 정반대.
❌ ④ allowance: '용돈'은 가족이 주는 일상 돈, 학업 전용이 아님.
det.tip: scholarship = 장학금. academic scholarship(학업 장학금), athletic scholarship(운동 장학금).

questions.passage: Althea Gibson was an American athlete with many interests. Her __________ (achieve) in tennis and golf inspired many people around the world.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: achieve(동사: 달성하다) -> achievements(명사 복수: 업적들). 'Her achievements'는 소유격 뒤 복수 명사로 여러 업적을 지칭.
det.tip: achieve(달성하다) -> achievement(업적, 명사) -> achievements(업적들, 복수)

questions.passage: Althea Gibson was a __________ (profession) golfer who joined the LPGA in 1964. She had also excelled as a tennis player earlier in her career.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: profession(명사: 직업) -> professional(형용사: 전문적인, 프로의). 'a professional golfer'는 '프로 골퍼'로 명사 golfer를 수식.
det.tip: profession(직업) -> professional(형용사: 프로의) -> professionally(부사)

questions.passage: Althea Gibson, an American tennis player and professional golfer, was born in 1927 and grew up in Harlem, New York. She dropped out of school in the seventh grade but returned several years later to finish high school. After graduation, she attended Florida A&M, a historically black college, on a basketball scholarship. She was the first Black tennis player ever to compete in the U.S. Open Tennis Championships and at Wimbledon. She won the French Championships in 1956, then went on to win both Wimbledon and the US Open in 1957 and again in 1958. In 1971, she entered the Tennis Hall of Fame. Gibson pursued many diverse interests. She released one record album, Althea Gibson Sings, and appeared in the film The Horse Soldier. In 1964, she became the __________ to enter the Ladies Professional Golf Association (LPGA).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② first African American woman: 본문 원문 그대로, LPGA에 '최초로 진출한 흑인 여성'이라는 선구적 업적.
❌ ① only white female golfer: 'white'는 본문과 정반대.
❌ ③ youngest player in history: '최연소'는 본문에 언급 없음.
❌ ④ oldest retired athlete: '최고령 은퇴 선수'는 LPGA 진출과 무관.
det.tip: the first African American woman to V = 최초로 V한 흑인 여성. Gibson의 선구자적 위치.
